Name: Lost in the Mountains - Large yet Cozy Custom Farm Map
Author: LilietBorodina
Description:
[size=3][right][size=2]Shoutout to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17640]Lnh's Small Summit Farm[/url]﻿ for inspiration![/size][/right][/size][color=#fff2cc][size=4][b][center]
CURRENTLY BEING UPDATED TO 1.6.
[color=#93c47d]~the bus stop has been fixed~
~the mailbox has been fixed~
~the pet bowl has been fixed~
~moving the farmhouse has been fixed~
~the intro event has been fixed~[/color]
[color=#93c47d]~the waterfalls have been updated~[/color]
~maps: pending~

SUPPLEMENTAL MOD FOR EARTHY RECOLOR: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28296?tab=description]DaisyNiko's Earthy Map for Lost in the Mountains﻿[/url]endorsed and recommended!!!! thank you forever [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/63517856]N3cro92[/url] :D[/center]Prerequisites and recommendations:[/b][/size][/color]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (obviously) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url] for the quarry, the respawning stumps and some other features. Technically I guess FTM is optional and you can play without the FTM half, but why would you do that??? Also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], again technically optional but makes your life way easier.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url], absolutely mandatory, the map will break otherwise. Same for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9633]Extra Map Layers[/url]!
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12717]Fix TVs on Custom Farms[/url], optional. If you play on a replaced farm type instead of the custom farm type and set furniture to "default", your TV will be fine. But if you want to use the furniture picker option or the custom farm type, you'll want it.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10924?tab=description]Farm Combat Grants XP Too[/url]. Fully optional, but given you'll have plenty of opportunity for farm combat...
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16873?tab=description]Easy Farm Switcher[/url] if you want to switch to it mid-save :3

[b][color=#d9ead3][size=4]Features:[/size][/color][/b]
- Plenty of farmland accessible immediately - although it will need quite a bit of clearing out...
- Blocked off areas on the map only accessible after you upgrade your tools enough. Double your farmland, find berries and hardwood, get cooler quarry ores... but be careful at night!
- In the southwest lies a forest lake with a nice sandy beach. Go for a swim and relax!
- Gorgeous waterfalls, flowers and other vegetation surrounding the farmland. Grandpa knew how to pick a place to settle~
- Lookout spots to the surrounding panorama. This farm is high up!
- Forage opportunities abound. Look around and don't wait to collect everything you see!
- A shuffled layout. Explore and find where everything is!
- Easy access to the Backwoods, Bus Stop and Cindersap Forest. Don't worry, you don't have to manually walk across the entire width and height of the map, the farmer can get through the woods and the mountain caves without your input ^^
- Optional setting for tillable grass. Off by default - I promise you there's enough farmland, and there ARE ponds on it for all your rice
and other needs.
- Invisible barriers blocking off forests from NPCs. Slimes won't eat your cow... or you, looking for your cow. Either of those. No promises about the bats though...
- Pick your own furniture layout! But watch out for the TVs (see above in the prerequisites and recommendations section)
- Replace any farm map, or use the custom map type. Customizable!
- Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url], both green and orange fall, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor[/url], all variants of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18223?tab=description]Yri's Retro Recolor[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]. For other recolors, request compatibility in comments! I'll probably get around to it, hopefully.
- - Note that "recolor compatibility" refers to one (1) tile that occurs on the map exactly ten (10) times as a cliff face decoration, and also to the world map if you're using the custom farm type. The map is fully playable with any recolor already, so you can start while you wait for me to add compatibility~

[color=#c9daf8][size=4][b]Warnings:[/b][/size][/color]
- If you customize furniture or use the custom map type, you'll need the TV fix mod or you won't get a TV.
- Vanilla doesn't allow you to get combat XP in fights on your farm, so if you want to be rewarded for fighting in your own forest, install the mod above.
- [color=#ea9999][size=3]If you want to play on a different farm, disable/remove this mod's FTM pack or the entire mod!
[/size][/color]
[color=#d9d2e9][size=4][b]Additional Credits:[/b][/size][/color]
- Shoutout to all the wonderful people on the Stardew Valley Discord for helping me make it through this project! Especially to the amazing mod creators who made this possible and then also helped <3
- Screenshots feature [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval Buildings[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18394]More Skin Tone Options[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/176]Umbreon Cat Replacer[/url]!

[color=#ead1dc][b]Coming soon (or not very soon) (if at all):[/b][/color]
[size=1]- customized fishing with separate fishing zones
- i18 translations into Ukrainian and Russian
- support for more recolors (VERY maybe)[/size]

Downloads.Description: This is a patch for the quarry in the event you prefer a more vanilla experience there. Removes chances of iridium, radioactive ore, mythic ore, omni geodes or cinder shards in the quarry. To use, paste/extract into the mod folder and replace the files.
